subject: Mystic Avenue Zoning and Housing Definitions
overview: The Planning and Permitting Committee reviewed proposed zoning ordinance updates with consultants Innes Associates, focusing on housing definitions and zoning maps and standards for the Mystic Avenue corridor. The committee recommended adjustments to the proposed definitions and requested further review of commercial and industrial allowances before keeping the paper in committee.

items.title: Housing Definitions Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed definitions for co-living, co-housing, and single-room occupancy, and voted to incorporate Cambridge's dormitory definition while striking language concerning permanent residences elsewhere.

items.title: Mystic Avenue Zoning Proposal and Dimensional Standards
items.summary: The committee evaluated map adjustments along Mystic Avenue to accommodate existing auto-oriented commercial parcels, discussed dimensional regulations and story minimums, and directed the steering committee and staff to refine industrial and commercial standards.
